blocks.text: PROPHETIC PARABLE— “‘This parable will reach its final culmination in the closing of our age! It reveals four type of hearers, the parable is found in Matt. chap. 13 and Luke chap. 8!’’ — ‘‘Jesus said many prophets and righteous men had desired to hear and see these things, but they did not have the opportunity! But we in our age have the privilege of seeing it fulfilled!’’ (Matt. 13:17) — ‘‘Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower! The parable opens, ‘the seed is the Word of God!’ ’’ (Luke 8:11) — ‘‘It is Jesus that soweth the Word! He that understandeth not the Word of the kingdom (by faith) the devil catches it away! These are those that received seed by the wayside!’’ (Matt. 13:19) — ‘‘How often today even many who have seen miracles are too busy in other things and take it lightly! These are those that fell by the wayside!’’ — ‘‘Next — ‘He that heareth the Word in stony places with joy, receiveth it. Having not root, he is offended by persecution because of the Word!’ ’’ (Vr. 21) — ‘‘Today we see people seemingly doing alright until they are persecuted a little bit, and because they are not really rooted and grounded by the Word they just seem to fall away quickly!”’

CONTINUING— ‘‘Next — He that heareth among the thorns, it says the riches and cares of this world choke out the Word and he becometh unfruitful! (Vr. 22) — How often we see these last two hearers today! We see it in the great falling away; and the apostasy in the land is incredible! Even some national churches condoned a new motion picture that portrayed Jesus in every form of sin that He actually spoke against! In fact it is so terrible we will just conclude by saying nudity and degradation was used in the film! No doubt some of you have heard about it in the news!’’ — ‘‘Now, the last listeners were the good ones! He that heareth the Word in good ground, and bringeth forth fruit! Some a hundred fold, some sixty, some thirty! (Vr. 23) — These were they that were not too busy with the cares of this life to hear the Word and to understand it!’’ — ‘‘They were rooted and grounded in it! These are the elect and they are working with this type of ministry in the harvest field! They have faith in the Word, and they receive power to become the sons of God!’’ — ‘‘All of this is fulfilling before our very eyes and reveals Jesus is standing at the door, ready to appear!”’ — Jesus said, ‘‘Blessed are they that hear and keep the Word. For He likened them unto a wise man which built his house upon a rock!”’ (Matt. 7:24-25) — ‘‘And the voice of the Lord told me to call my Headquarters Church, Capstone! For it is founded upon the rock, the Lord Jesus!’”

THE UNITED STATES IN PROPHECY— “‘It has been a great nation, and it is now over 200 years old! But in the last 30 years the U.S.A. has begun to deteriorate in such a way that her time will be shortened! The Hollywood films have polluted the world, and there are more harlots on the street than there are true preachers in the pulpit!’’ — ‘‘The rapid use of drugs is destroying this nation within! The youth are perishing before our eyes! This nation also has the largest debt of all nations, and some day soon will have to give an account! Also like Babylon of old it is a mixture of all nationalities on this earth! So we can safely say that soon it will be called a daughter of Great Babylon!’’ (Rev. 17) — ‘‘This nation will also be associated with the revived Roman Empire! (Rev. chap. 13) — Let us pray for the nation and for the youth, believing the Lord will bring many more to salvation; before the dark shadows of the Tribulation converge upon the land!”’ HEAVENLY SIGNS — Gen. 1:14, ‘‘reveals the heavens will give forth signs! . . . And Jesus said in Luke 21:25 there would be signs in the sun, the moon and the stars! As was in His first coming, and so will He in His Second Coming!’’ — ‘‘This is the year of strange planetary movements of which we have discussed in other Scripts! Some of it has already come to pass, weather and etc.!’’ — ‘‘One of the things is that Mars makes its closest approach to earth than it has in a generation! Some have called it the astronomical event of 1988! By the end of September they expect it to rival Jupiter as the brightest object in the sky! Scientists claim it won’t be this close again until after the year 2000!’’ — ‘‘Also we see the year 1988 marks the 40th birthday of the state of Israel! . . . And since our first writings we have seen riots in the streets of Israel! . . . And trouble was predicted in the Scripts!’’ — ‘‘All of these signs speak of change, and this nation (U.S.A.) has reached a turning point! Will it wake up? Or will it go into a deeper sleep (delusion)?’’ — ‘‘The event we spoke above will occur close to our 1988 election and should denote an unusual one!”’ — ‘Evidently the charismatic leader that God revealed to me will occur in another cycle! But who knows when the next president takes office such a change can come in leadership or can take on this characteristic!’’ — ‘‘One thing for certain many of the prophecies I wrote about that the next president will do in office will definitely take place exactly as spoken! . . . But one way or another this leader that was spoke of will rise! Also what about this last religious leader the Scripts spoke of? (Rev. 13:12-17) — Could it be this — and how near is it? Soon time and destiny will reveal it! The years ahead will be most interesting indeed!’’

JESUS IN PROPHECY— How will He come? — ‘‘He will come suddenly and He will come quickly! He will appear in clouds of glory! When the Word and signs are fulfilled just right the Translation will take place in a moment, in a twinkling of an eye! Why will He come?’’ — “To fulfill a promise, to redeem His own so we may escape as He judges the earth!’’ — When will He come? — ‘‘No one knows the exact day nor hour, but we will know the season! We see by the time cycles and the signs around us of which He spoke (droughts, quakes, famines, inventions, atomic, nation’s in perplexity and etc.) that it is near!’’ — Let’s take notice . . . ‘‘The first time Jesus came was just before the ending of the century of the first 4000 years; about 3996!’’ — ‘‘Now it could be almost the same way in our century give or take a year or two or even earlier (time to be shortened)! We know it’s soon — and my opinion is, that it is definitely possible again before this century ends! But one thing for certain we are in the season of His coming!’’ — ‘The Lord Himself shall descend!’’ (I Thess. 4:16)

GOG IN PROPHECY— ‘“‘As you know I predicted that a Russian leader would rise about the time of the anti-christ and work with him! . . . So we would like to print this very interesting article here. . . and it starts — Have we met ‘Gog’?’’ — Message of the Christian Jew Hour! Quote: In the opening verses of Ezekiel 38, we read: ‘‘And the Word of the Lord (the preincarnate Christ — see John 1:1-5) came unto me, saying, Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh (Russia), Meshech (Moscow) and Tubal (Tobolsk), and prophecy against him, And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Rosh (Russia), Meshech (Moscow) and Tubal (Tobolsk); And I will turn thee around, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army. . . . Persia (Iran), Ethiopia and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet: Gomer (East Germany) and all his bands: the house of Togarmah (Turkey) of the uttermost parts of the north, and all his bands: and many people with thee’’ (Ezekiel 38:1-6, Literal Translation). These verses introduce a detailed prophecy . . . describing the rise and demise of a future (from Ezekiel’s viewpoint) leading political figure, ruler over the land of Russia, who is given the personal name of ‘‘Gog.’’ This deceitful and ambitious “prince,’’ exercising his own evil will through the direct permission of God, leads a powerful Soviet Bloc army against God’s Chosen People Israel, determined to confiscate the wealth of this little reclaimed nation. . .. Gog leads his huge army to ‘‘the mountains of Israel.’’. .. Where God through supernatural means, destroys Gog’s army and brings about the death and burial of Gog himself.

CONTINUING— Early in December 1987, the American people had their first intimate introduction to Mikhail Gorbachev, the present General Secretary of the Supreme Soviet and the political leader (the “prince’’) of the nation Russia. . . . He revealed himself to be a highly intelligent man of charm and wit; one who captured social as well as political attention. . . . Another unique feature . . . is the flaming “‘birthmark.’’ . . . To the ancients, such a mark was considered to be a supernatural ‘‘brand,’’ placed by the ‘‘gods.’’. . . However, there is something of far more significance than a ‘‘birthmark.’’ . .» That ‘‘something”’ is the name that belongs to this man. . . . When we go to the Russian language spelling of ‘‘Gorbachev,’’ we find something of much greater significance. The first syllable, ‘‘Gor-’’ . . . is spelled with four letters rather than three. The Russian spelling . . . repeats the initial letter. . . before the... ‘‘r.’’ thus, the Russians spell ‘‘Gorbachev’’ as ‘‘Gogrbachev.’’. . . The first three letters . . . literally spell ‘‘Gog!’’ Is this mere coincidence? Not only that, but let’s consider the first name. . . . The Russian ‘‘Mikhail’’ is

. the Hebrew-derived name ‘‘Michael.’’ The Hebrew meaning . . . ls “‘he who is like God.’’ This is a most appropriate name for one who is to defy the authority of God by attacking . . . Israel! Have we met the ‘‘Gog”’ of Ezekiel’s prophecy? Only time will answer that question. — End of Quote! — This alone shows us that the prince of Gog is near! As it further stated indeed, time will tell . . . perhaps
